in_marathi.name: Girivar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Girivar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Giri', meaning mountain, and 'Var', meaning protector. This name is given to those who are believed to protect and preserve the mountains and nature. In Hindu mythology, it is also the name of a sage who is known for his wisdom and knowledge.
